title: Guidance – Agentic Field Technician Assistant
tools: AI Agents (Google Gemini) · Application Development (Python, React)
blurb: Won 1st place in the beginner track of 20 teams. A technician photographs a machine and asks a question; a multimodal Gemini agent answers aloud and draws the next step onto the photo.
long: Built end to end in 24 hours with a team at BeaverHacks 2026, winning 1st place in the beginner track of 20 teams.

A technician captures photos from a laptop webcam or a paired phone, then asks a question by voice or text. A multi-stage Gemini pipeline analyses the images, answers in spoken-style guidance, draws an annotated diagram on the photo showing the next action, and reads the answer aloud.

Machine manuals are retrieved locally (RAG, retrieval-augmented generation) through function calling, scoped by a QR code on each machine, and task state persists so the assistant remembers what has already been tried.
highlights: Image + audio input, spoken output, annotated diagrams
